name: India
summary: Strongest on DPI rails and public-private institutions; weakest on compute and measured impact.
method: Scored against the same anchors respondents use, from the public material in the pre-reads. Score what operates at national scale today; score the national picture; where a law exists but its obligations are not yet in force, score at most 3.

P1.evidence: Aadhaar covers over 1.3 billion people; UPI handles billions of payments a month; DigiLocker and ONDC are live on open APIs
P1.assumption: Rails are already usable as AI distribution channels

P2.evidence: Account Aggregators live in finance; ABDM in health; AIKosh datasets published; DEPA training and clean rooms at an early stage
P2.assumption: Data for training is available but uneven across sectors

P3.evidence: Aadhaar eKYC at scale; Account Aggregator consent live; DPDP Rules notified Nov 2025, with consent-manager and fiduciary obligations phasing in through 2026–27
P3.assumption: Consent for AI training and AI agents is not yet operational

P4.evidence: IndiaAI Compute Portal with tens of thousands of subsidised GPUs; Indic foundation models funded; data-centre, energy and chip supply still constrained
P4.assumption: Compute access is improving but small next to demand

P5.evidence: Very large engineering workforce and high AI-skills penetration; thinner frontier research and PhD depth; limited AI capacity among officials
P5.assumption: Breadth is strong, depth is the gap

P6.evidence: AI Governance Guidelines (Nov 2025); IndiaAI Safety Institute; sector guidance from RBI and ICMR; IT Rules on synthetic content; no horizontal AI law
P6.assumption: Principles-based approach is deliberate, but enforcement and testing capacity are still forming

P7.evidence: NPCI and Sahamati as neutral Section 8 operators; iSPIRT and volunteer-tech model; IndiaAI compute delivered through private providers
P7.assumption: The model carries over from payments and data to AI

P8.evidence: Bhashini for Indian languages and voice; strong DPI inclusion record; few published outcome metrics for AI deployments
P8.assumption: Inclusion strength from DPI has not yet been shown for AI
